text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I guide pedestrians across the crosswalk in front of the station every morning, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Looking at phones while walking, riding bicycles on the sidewalk...
Cars that only pause for a split second at stop signs.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I was racking my brain trying to figure out a solution, and then my head started hurting...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno's headache seemed
to have quite deep roots.
